Package com.signalwire.sdk.relay

Class Call

java.lang.Object
com.signalwire.sdk.relay.Call
public class Call extends Object
Represents a RELAY call with 30+ methods organized by category.

Methods are grouped into:

  • Simple fire-and-response: answer, hangup, pass, hold, etc.
  • Action-based: play, record, detect, collect, etc. (return Action)
  • Connection: connect, disconnect, transfer
  • Conference: joinConference, leaveConference
  • AI: ai, aiMessage, aiHold, aiUnhold, amazonBedrock
Event routing: the RelayClient routes events to calls by call_id. Each call maintains an actions map keyed by control_id for action events.

    • getCallState

      public Optional<CallState> getCallState()
      The current call state as a typed CallState, alongside the raw string getState() (which stays canonical for parity and forward-compat). Returns Optional.empty() when the live wire state is not one of the five known CallState values — the set mirrors server-emitted values that can grow, so an unrecognised state is tolerated here rather than crashing the caller. The present value always agrees with getState(): getCallState().get().getValue().equals(getState()).
      Returns:
      the typed state, or empty if the raw state is unknown/unset.
